message.content: {"decision":"reject","reason":"The article discusses challenges in tech hiring due to AI-generated resumes and introduces Stack Overflow's Developer Story as a hiring improvement, but it does not address coding agents, their use by learners, or effects on programming education or workflows relevant to Apprentice Mode's audience.","piece_ids":[],"strongest_claim":"AI-generated resumes have made it harder to identify genuine talent in tech hiring, prompting Stack Overflow to revive Developer Story to better showcase candidates' real work and skills.","evidence_type":"assertion","perspective":"vendor","commercial_incentive":true}
